description: route byte-aligned Rho rotates (8,56) via PRMT to offload SHF; -0.14% vs 1895.1 baseline (within noise). selftest PASS => PRMT selectors correct/value-identical. Only 2/29 rotates byte-aligned so SHF relief too small; SHA3-256 not SHF-port-bound at scalar config (unlike SM3).

Theta: compute all 5 D-values into separate live temps before applying (value-identical XOR reassoc; selftest PASS). -1.86% vs 1895.1. ncu: m17400_s04 is ALU-pipe-bound 98.9%, IPC 2.02, register-limited (block-limit-reg=3, 50% occ). SASS: 677 LOP3 (bottleneck) vs 282 SHF. ptxas already materializes Theta D once + 2-input XOR applies (0x3c) = its register-optimal point; exposing 5 live D regs spills/regresses. Roofline: LOP3-bound, no free pipe (PRMT/SHF-offload already tried -0.14%), Chi/Theta algebraically minimal, lane-complement gives 0 on LOP3 hw.

force #pragma unroll on 23-round Keccak loop (both m/s). -0.23% vs 1895.1 baseline (within noise). module_17400 sets no _unroll so loop was rolled; unroll enables round-0 zero-folding + rndc immediates + drops per-round loop-counter IADD, but ALU pipe already saturated (98.9%) at register-cliff occupancy (block-limit-reg=3, 50%): freed loop-overhead ops are a tiny fraction and unroll cannot lift the register-limited occupancy. Confirms LOP3/roofline; loop stays rolled for good reason.

Peel round 0 out of the rolled loop as straight-line code (rounds 1-22 stay rolled). Initial state has 16 zero lanes + a31 constant, so round-0 Theta parities collapse (5-term XOR->1 term) and D-application into zero lanes folds to free moves; compiler can only fold this when round 0 is straight-line, not inside the rolled loop. +2.30% (1938.6) confirm +2.51% (1942.7) vs 1895.1, selftest PASS => value-identical. Unlike exp3 full unroll (-0.23%, register blowup from 23 rounds), peeling one round adds ~0 register pressure across the loop boundary. First real win: cuts dynamic LOP3 on the 98.9% ALU-bound pipe.

Fold Theta D-application into per-lane 3-input XOR (a = a ^ bc ^ rotl) instead of materializing t = bc[x-1] ^ rotl(bc[x+1],1) then 5 two-input XORs. ptxas now emits one XOR3 (LOP3) per lane = 5 LOP3/column vs 6 (t + 5 applies), dropping the separate t op; parity bc is already live across the D-phase so register pressure is unchanged. Value-identical XOR reassoc, selftest PASS. +10.8% (2147.5, confirm 2148.1) vs prior best 1938.6 (+13.4% vs baseline 1895.1). Big delta vs the naive 1-LOP3/round count suggests the op reduction also relieved the block-limit-reg=3 register cliff, lifting occupancy on the 98.9% ALU-bound pipe. Directly cuts dynamic LOP3, the proven bottleneck.

ROOFLINE conclusion (no code change; HEAD stays at best 7cb3d1a14). Confirm re-measure 2146.4 (within noise of best 2147.5/2148.1), selftest PASS. Per-round LOP3 floor is met: Theta parity (5-way XOR expr -> 2 XOR3/col = 10), Theta D-apply (a=a^bc^t -> 1 XOR3/lane = 25; materializing D regressed exp67a7b), and Chi (a^=~b&c -> 1 LOP3/lane = 25) each sit at 1-LOP3-per-output, in ptxas fuse-friendly single-expression form (the same form that made the exp6 D-apply XOR3 fuse). ncu 98.9% ALU pipe, IPC ~2.02, block-limit-reg=3/50% occ. Untried ideas all reasoned-dead: hc_lop_0x96 is u32x-only (identical lowering for u64); lane-complement gives 0 on LOP3 hw; bit-interleave adds LOP3 while only relieving SHF (not the bound; PRMT-offload already -0.14%); peel-round-1 has no zero lanes left to fold (dense after round-0 Theta, like the -0.23% full-unroll); Iota-fold into Chi is net-zero (rndc is a 4th input, needs its own op); ILP-reorder cannot help a 98.9%-saturated throughput pipe. Several principled discards logged (PRMT, materialize-D, full-unroll). SHA3-256 m17400 is at LOP3 roofline.

Directly compute only the four live post-Rho/Pi lanes in the final round from their Theta-adjusted sources, removing the source-level 18-step in-place carry chain and dead D-applications (value-identical; selftest PASS). +1.01% vs best 2147.5, inside the stated ~1-2% noise band, so discard; likely ptxas already eliminated most of the dead final-round chain.

Partially unroll the 22-round hot loop by a factor of two in both multi- and single-hash paths, halving loop-control overhead without the code-size/register-pressure cost of the previously tried full unroll. +2.68% vs best 2147.5, beyond the 1-2% noise band; selftest PASS.
